title: v2 loads data with fewer, faster requests
summary: Rows from one promoted-hubs request per server, pages restored instantly and refreshed quietly with placeholders, TMDB and the kids index in parallel.

rows.text: Apollo /hubs/sections/1 17.99 s vs /hubs/promoted for both film libraries 2.10 s; Maverick 2.56 s vs 1.15 s for three libraries.

brief.direction: Replace per-library hub requests with one promoted-hubs request per server; replace blank-and-rebuild page switches with per-page snapshots and in-place refresh; run TMDB and per-server index work in parallel.

rejected.why: mixes music and other libraries; promoted with contentDirectoryID is scoped to the page's libraries

rejected.option: Take Continue watching from the promoted hubs
rejected.why: the deck has its own rules (devices.mine, one tile per show); left as is

rejected.option: Parallel requests to one Plex server
rejected.why: servers we do not own: one at a time per server

decided: sometimes it loads and then refreshes which is not ideal
lets make one call for several rows that makes more sense
optimise all calls to minimise requests but at the fastest speed

challenge.skipped: Stuart named the direction; the measured endpoint settles the main choice
